name: Splash Portal
description: Exile target creature you control, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control. If that creature is a Bird, Frog, Otter, or Rat, draw a card.
couldNotDerive: That the returned/checked object is the exiled CREATURE, not this Sorcery -- Defined$Remembered wrongly triggers the selfMove heuristic (meant for Jecht's own self-transform pattern), producing the nonsensical 'this Sorcery enters the battlefield'.
notes: Real bug, same Defined$<sibling-reference> family already documented, a new concrete instance: ChangeZone's selfMove heuristic treats Defined$Remembered as ALWAYS meaning 'this card returns as itself' (correct for Jecht's own exile-transform-return, where the card remembers its OWN exile) -- but here Defined$Remembered refers to an EXTERNALLY targeted-and-exiled creature (RememberTargets$True on an earlier step), producing a genuinely wrong, confusing fact (a Sorcery 'entering the battlefield'). A correct fix needs to know whether the EARLIER step that set Remembered was itself targeted or self-referential -- requires threading extra context through many recursive calls, not attempted given the scope. cond:if_present on the draw is otherwise correctly captured via qualifierFlags/ifPresentFlag machinery (bird/frog/otter/rat -- though only the first type of the OR list would show given known multi-clause limits).
